# Welcome to Harbor Help

Harbor Help connects you with an adviser by **video appointment**. You need a
device with a camera and the [Harbor Help app](https://harbor.example/app).

## Before your first appointment

1. Install the app and sign in with your library card number.
2. Test your camera under **Settings > Video**.
3. Keep your appointment code, for example `HB-2041`, ready.

Read more in [Preparing for a video appointment](https://harbor.example/help/prepare).
